d:
We hope you saw a bit of your own family in Part 1.
The little changes you notice in your parents. The things you start doing for them without even thinking about it. And that quiet realisation that the people who once took care of everything for you now need you a little more.
Here’s Part 2 of our story, a continuation of those everyday moments that remind us that growing up also means learning to take care of the ones who raised us.
Because sometimes love looks like a big gesture.
And sometimes, it’s just making their everyday life a little easier.
